prompt:
Use case: product-mockup.
Create ONE premium photorealistic café catalogue image, portrait 3:4, matching the provided cleaned master product photo. The reference is the exact drink identity AND typography master. Photograph the same product in the new scene below.
CRITICAL invariants: same squat short broad clear plastic sundae cup, rounded bottom and clear hemispherical dome lid; same natural layered drink of beige Earl Grey infused milk below, deep matcha green marbling above, modest ivory cold foam with light matcha dusting fully INSIDE the dome. Preserve a distinct THIN amber-brown Earl Grey syrup strip right at the bottom, only about 4–5% of the LIQUID height, exactly like master. Do not make a thick brown layer. Keep foam low and contained, do not add a whipped cream tower.
Packaging MUST be professionally clean: absolutely no spills, no overflow, no green foam, liquid or residue ON the outside clear flange/rim, cup exterior or dome exterior. The extended clear lid flange should be transparent, dry and spotless with clean highlights; green seen through liquid inside cup must not look like smears on flange. Tiny transparent cold condensation droplets on cup body are fine.
Faithfully keep compact front mascot sticker: smiling brown-haired girl with pink bow, white bunny with exactly TWO ears, legible 128am Cafe lettering. No redesign or oversized sticker.
Text: EXACT lowercase heading "earl grey matcha latte", in TWO centered lines: "earl grey" / "matcha latte"; same large bold Fredoka-style rounded typography as master, rose #B8496C. Small exact "128am Cafe" in cocoa below heading. Safe generous margins and clear empty background behind all text. Match master font, line breaks and overall layout. Product fills lower two thirds, entire dome and entire cup base in frame, front sticker fully visible.
Style: appetising polished PHOTOREALISTIC commercial food photograph, natural light, credible plastics, soft dimensional shadows, sharp subject, realistic colour. Brand cream #FFF8F5, blush #FDE5EB, sage #E7F0DC. Not illustration or CGI. No prices, claims, watermark, borders, extra text, fruits, additional toppings, straws or hands. No collage.
Scene: Cup on warm cream window bench, softly blurred cream wall and window to left, gentle morning light and faint window shadows, peaceful minimal setting.
visual_qa: Passed: full cup, clean exterior rim/dome, thin amber syrup base, correct typography and two-ear bunny.
